messages:
Priya: :rotating_light: Escalation from AtlasAI — spike of 502/504s since 09:12 UTC after a split-wave rollout. Seeing ~12% error rate on /v1/generate. Customers timing out. Raising in #incidents.

OpsBot: Deploy initiated: rollout id r-2026-03-17-2 -> traffic 20%.

James: Confirmed alerts in Sentry and Datadog. Edge gateway logs show upstream resets and `auth/http timeout` in api-router traces.

Aya: Any feature flags flipped? Canary included an auth KV cache change + header rewrite. Checking rollout config now.

Maria: Quick look at canary nodes — auth-kv volume `auth-cache-v2` not mounted on a subset of node-pool-3. Might explain intermittent cache misses.

Priya: Customer repro attached: `curl -v -H "x-customer-token: <redacted>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` returns `502 Bad Gateway` intermittently. Snippet from api-router:
```
2026-03-17T09:12:42.123Z ERROR upstream reset: connection reset by peer id=auth-backend-12
2026-03-17T09:12:42.125Z WARN auth client timeout=1500ms key=missing
```

James: I can repro with traffic replay — when auth-kv misses, auth backend spikes and times out. Hypothesis: header rewrite changed cache key -> miss storm -> auth backend overload -> gateway 502.

Aya: Short fix: revert header rewrite on canary pods or gate the new auth-kv. Can we hotpatch canary to disable it before a full rollback?

Maria: We could scale auth-backend and add temporary rate limiting, but customer SLAs require faster action. Recommend rollback.

Priya: CS notes: 6 enterprise customers impacted, started support calls. They want ETA and mitigation.

James: Decision: rollback split-wave rollout to stable (r-2026-03-16-stable). @OpsBot kick off rollback and drop canary traffic to 0%.

OpsBot: Rollback triggered by @James — target rollout r-2026-03-17-2 -> 0% over 2m. Monitoring progress.

Aya: Filing follow-up ticket: enforce preflight checks for KV mount, add e2e replay for header rewrite, and add canary gating for auth changes. Postmortem owner: Aya.

Maria: I'll sync with infra to fix node-pool mounts and run smoke tests across all regions.

Priya: :white_check_mark: CS notified AtlasAI and posted interim workaround. ETA given: 20m for rollback + validation.

OpsBot: Rollback complete. Canary traffic 0%. Health checks stable.

James: Metrics update: 502s dropped from 12% -> 0.8% in 10m. Closing immediate fire. Action items:
- fix KV mount and node-pool selector
- add cfg gating for header rewrites
- increase auth-backend autoscale thresholds
- add replay test to deployment pipeline

Aya: Will own follow-up and coordinate postmortem. Tagging incident INC-2026-0317-123 for tracking.

Maria: I'll run a post-rollback canary smoke across all regions and report back.

Priya: Thanks team — CS will continue customer comms and escalate if anything else pops up.
